run_benchmark_evaluation: run the benchmark function to evaluate video object segmentation predictions against ground truth masks across datasets
create_video_evaluator: create a VideoEvaluator instance to evaluate a single video's predicted masks against ground truth masks
run_evaluator_feed_frame: run the Evaluator class to feed frame-by-frame mask and ground truth pairs for IoU and boundary F-score computation
convert_segmentation_to_boundary_map: convert a segmentation mask to a binary boundary map using the _seg2bmap function for boundary analysis
compute_iou_score: compute the Intersection over Union score between two masks using the get_iou function with intersection and pixel sum
